blocks.text: A textual question arises at Jesus’ baptism: most witnesses give the familiar Synoptic wording of the heavenly voice, while Codex Bezae and some patristic evidence preserve the words, “Today I have begotten you,” from Psalm 2:7. This is a disputed textual variation, so questions about the wording of the voice should be distinguished from broader judgments about its meaning. The genealogy that follows traces Jesus backward through David and Abraham to Adam and God. It differs substantially from Matthew’s genealogy in its names, direction, placement, and organizing aims; proposed harmonizations are later attempts to relate the two accounts.

sections.title: Questions about the baptismal voice and genealogy
